verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Replit's scheduled routines: a recurring job can run on a schedule and report back (replit-docs-49). That is a time-based trigger, not a general rule engine that fires actions on events. Background tasks (replit-docs-48) run when the user starts them, not on events. Missing for 10: event-based triggers (e.g., webhooks, app or data changes, integration events), user-defined conditional rules, documentation of trigger and action configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
